svg.title: Effective Permission followed by business gates
svg.desc: A client presents session proof and never supplies a trusted ActorId. Server/IAM establishes ActorContext. The owner asks Access Policy with ActorContext, Permission, ResourceId, Scope and expected state; Access Policy resolves IAM eligibility through a read-only query port, then Project and Group membership, assignments, role versions and Scope hierarchy, and returns an immutable AuthorizationDecision. The owner records a separate business-gate/final outcome. At commit, authorization inputs and owner state revalidate inside one relational unit of work with Audit Evidence and outbox. A revoked decision cannot fall through to an owner write.

g.text: [owner state or business gate is stale]

svg.text: Authorize(ActorContext, Permission, ResourceId, Scope, expected state)
Read current eligibility and security version
Commit-time revalidate ActorContext and policy/membership pins
Read current eligibility through read-only query port
Append material evidence in the same UoW
